description: MCU Cortex-M4F 170MHz, FDCAN, USB FS, 3x opamp/PGA, 2x ADC, LQFP-48
Crystal 3225 4-pin (CAN bit timing accuracy)
14-bit magnetic angle encoder, SSI/I2C/ABZ, SOP-8 (faces shaft magnet)
Half-bridge gate driver, HIN/LIN active-high, 8-20V, UVLO 7V, 250ns dead time + shoot-through lockout
Dual N-MOSFET 40V 20A 13mOhm PDFN3x3-8, one package per half-bridge (alt: AP4008QD C2828588)
Current-sense shunt 1206 1% (low side of one leg per H-bridge)
Bootstrap diode SOD-123 (EG2132 has no internal diode)
Gate resistor 0402
CAN transceiver 5V with 3.3V VIO (TJA1051T/3 pin-compatible), SOP-8
RS-485 half-duplex transceiver 3.3V SOIC-8
Dual bidirectional bus TVS SOT-23 (CANH/A, CANL/B)
Bus termination 0603 (enabled by solder jumper JP1)
60V 1.2A async buck converter ESOP-8 (VM to 5.3V)
Shielded power inductor 4x4x3mm >=1A
Schottky 60V 1A SMA, buck catch diode
Schottky 40V 1A SOD-123, 5V rail OR-ing (buck / USB VBUS)
LDO 3.3V 200mA SOT-23
Ferrite bead 0603 for VDDA
P-MOSFET 40V 30A 10mOhm PDFN3x3-8, reverse-polarity protection
NPN 160V SOT-23, gate-rail emitter follower
Zener 12V SOD-123 (Q1 gate clamp, gate-rail reference)
TVS 600W 26V standoff SMB, supply clamp
Fuse 1206 fast-acting
Aluminium electrolytic SMD 8x10mm, bulk VM
MLCC X5R 1206, VM bypass at each half-bridge
MLCC X7R 0402 (HF bypass at bridges, buck bootstrap)
MLCC X7R 0805, buck input
MLCC X5R 0805, buck output
MLCC X5R 0805, gate rail bulk
MLCC X7R 0603 (4x bootstrap, 4x driver VCC, VDDA, VREF+, encoder, LDO in)
MLCC X5R 0603 (LDO out, MCU bulk, 5V rail)
MLCC X7R 0402 general decoupling / filters
MLCC 0402, current-sense input filter (tau 0.2 us with 1k)
MLCC 0402, crystal load
MLCC 0402, digital input filters
0402 1% (ENC_CS pullup, NTC divider, RS-485 RO pullup)
0402 1% (8x gate-source bleed, Q1 gate, buck EN)
0402 1% (2x current-sense series, 2x LED)
0402 1% current-sense bias to VDDA (sets ~1.7V mid-scale offset after PGA x16)
0402 Kelvin return links to OPAMP VINM0
0402 1% VBUS divider top
0402 1% VBUS divider bottom
0402 pulldowns on the 8 gate-driver inputs (all FETs off while MCU is in reset/bootloader)
0603 gate-rail zener bias (42 mW at 26 V)
0402 1% buck feedback top
0402 1% buck feedback bottom (shares reel with R1..R3)
0402 USB-C CC pulldowns
0402 series protection on STEP/DIR/EN/LIM1/LIM2
NTC 0402 B3435 next to the bridges
USB Type-C receptacle, USB 2.0, SMD
4-line ESD array SOT-23-6 (USB D+/D-/VBUS, IO header)
User button (hold at power-up: calibrate / restore defaults)
Status LED (pin high); shares PC13 with LED2
Fault LED (pin low); pin hi-Z = both off
IO header: 5V, GND, STEP, DIR, EN, AUX
Limit switches: 3V3, GND, LIM1, LIM2
Micro-Fit-compatible 3.0mm 2x2 right-angle, power + bus in/out (V+, GND, H/A, L/B), 5A/pin
Motor connector JST-XH 4-pin vertical (A+, A-, B+, B-)
